subject: Request: short-term trial grace window after engineering snag
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@phoenixinference.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Connor Hayes <connor.hayes@phoenixinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO C kickoff/next steps (trial active)

Jonas — quick update from our side. We ran into a blocker this morning while wiring the connector to our ingestion pipeline: the SDK adapter expects a slightly different JSON schema for event batching than your sample. Our engineers are already paired with your docs but it’s going to take an extra sprint to align the transformer.

We’re still excited to move forward but that delay eats into our trial window. Can Redwood pause/extend the trial by two weeks while we finish the adapter change? Without a bit more runway we’ll miss our demo window to leadership.

Attached the latest security questionnaire and our updated scope file for visibility.

—Sasha
Sasha Patel
Head of ML Platform
Phoenix Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: security-answers-phoenix.pdf (pdf, 230KB); poc-scope-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@phoenixinference.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO C kickoff/next steps (trial active)

Hi Sasha — thanks for the transparency and for sending the docs. Sorry to hear about the schema mismatch; glad your team spotted it early.

Short answer: yes, we can provide an extra window. I want to align internally on how much runway to offer and whether we attach any stipulations (e.g., completion of the adapter merge, short follow-up demo).

Priyom / Marissa — can you weigh in on a two week extension vs. a three week buffer? Also flag any billing/entitlement constraints I should call out to the customer. If Sales Ops needs a quick formal approval, I can send the ask.

Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 06 Mar 2028 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO C kickoff/next steps (trial active)

Quick internal:
- Given Phoenix is in an active POC and the blocker is engineering-side, recommend we offer a 21-calendar-day extension (three weeks). That aligns with our recent precedent for integration snags and keeps the deal cadence.
- No additional free compute beyond the active trial quota unless they request an increase explicitly. We should clarify token limits in the confirmation note.
- I’ll prep the formal extension email and loop in Sales Ops for an admin signoff.

Marissa — can you confirm there’s no contractual blocker on granting a 21-day extension for this deal id (DL-4391)? If yes, I’ll send to Sasha with the updated timeline and a DocuSign acknowledgement to keep records tidy.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Mid-Market | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 Mar 2028 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO C kickoff/next steps (trial active)

Confirmed — Sales Ops is fine with a 21-day extension for DL-4391. No changes needed to entitlements; trial quota stays the same. We’ll generate a brief addendum: start date = current trial end + 1 day; duration = 21 days; customer to confirm adapter merge and a short demo at the end of the window. Will attach DocuSign link to the note.

Priyom — please send the extension message to Sasha and Connor. Jonas — nice one for owning the ask.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
